observable_evidence: fixture inputs and fake tool states
process exit code and structured validator result
git branch, HEAD, diff, and modified files
non_observable_evidence: model reasoning that is not emitted by a component
targets.trace_dependency: Only when the component contract explicitly requires a trace
targets.pass_condition: Every required assertion has same-target observable evidence and passes
targets.unknown_condition: A required evidence record is missing
targets.infra_error_condition: The component could not produce evidence because its execution environment failed

observable_evidence: candidate sandbox filesystem and git outcome
non_observable_evidence: tool arguments, tool results, and source provenance until the Phase 2 log schema is verified
targets.trace_dependency: Tool-path and retrieval assertions require Phase 2 trace proof
targets.pass_condition: Not available in Phase 0-1; the target is not executed
targets.infra_error_condition: Reserved for Phase 2 launch, bridge, provider, or sandbox failures

observable_evidence: only the tool activity that the product actually exposes
targets.trace_dependency: Internal process assertions remain UNKNOWN without a supported trace
targets.pass_condition: Every required Work assertion has actual Work or external-state evidence and passes
targets.unknown_condition: A required internal-process or version assertion lacks supported evidence
targets.infra_error_condition: Work, connector, authentication, or external-state access prevents the observation
